Subtract 299 days from 1842-11-29.  
1842 is not a leap year.  
299 days back: go to 1842-02-02 (29 days back to Nov 1, plus 273 days back to Feb 2, since 1842 Feb has 28 days).  
Check: From 1842-02-02 to 1842-11-29 is 273 days (Jan 31, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, plus 29 days in Nov) = 273 days. 273 + 26 days into Jan? Wait, recalc:  
Better: Count backward:  
From 1842-11-29:  
Back 29 days → 1842-11-01.  
Back 31 days (Oct) → 1842-10-01.  
Back 30 days (Sep) → 1842-09-01.  
Back 31 days (Aug) → 1842-08-01.  
Back 31 days (Jul) → 1842-07-01.  
Back 30 days (Jun) → 1842-06-01.  
Back 31 days (May) → 1842-05-01.  
Back 30 days (Apr) → 1842-04-01.  
Back 31 days (Mar) → 1842-03-01.  
Back 28 days (Feb 1842) → 1842-02-01.  
Total days so far: 29+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31+28 = 302 days. That’s too many (we only need 299).  
We went from 1842-11-29 back to 1842-02-01 = 302 days. We need 299, so move forward 3 days from 1842-02-01 → 1842-02-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1842-02-04
